predecessors.name: Sui dynasty
predecessors.text: the Ordos and the bend of the Yellow River in northern Shaanxi and western Inner Mongolia: Cliopatria's Sui 626 shape, which is Liang Shidu's holding

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: the Ordos and the bend of the Yellow River in northern Shaanxi and western Inner Mongolia: Cliopatria's Sui 626 shape, which is Liang Shidu's holding

ledger.x: 622: the Tang take the eastern city of Shuofang.
628: Liang Shidu is killed and the Liang surrenders.

wars.name: Tang conquest of Liang Shidu's Liang
wars.outcome: Tang victory: the eastern city of Shuofang fell in 622 and the whole Liang in 628, the last rival regime of the Sui collapse.

certainty.note: A steppe-edge region on the Yellow River bend; the page gives no boundary.
